summary: restoration_lag 0 contradicts the consultant's own proposal: works no earlier than mid-2027, first measurable gain in the fourth year after that, 0.7 only by year 10. Time zero is the start of injury, late September 2024, so first gain falls about 6 years in and full gain about 12. The calculator holds gain constant and cannot model a ramp, so run-2 (lag 6, 22 years) and run-3 (lag 12, 16 years) bracket it; credit per hectare falls from 12.55 to 9.62 and 6.35. Other inputs are also unsettled: injury_years 5 assumes discharge to late 2029, against the closure prayer; recovery_years 12 is 'our judgement'; gain 0.7 sits above the creek's pre-project 0.58 and Site R has no starting score; the 3% discount rate is a US convention; 0.15 is a single August 2026 reading applied back to 2024.
provision: HEA credit and timing inputs (catalog entry hea; docs/METHODOLOGY.md)
recommendation: An ecologist of record must set each input. Ask for a restoration trajectory with its start score and a reasoned discount rate. Treat run-2 and run-3 as a bracket for that work, not as a replacement for it.
